notes: One written כִּי governs both coordinated clauses and the ASV rewrites its 'that' at the head of the second, so both occurrences are that morpheme's discontinuous unit under rule 55 while the waw keeps only its 'and' — the shape of לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ וְהַאֲרַכְתָּ יָמִים.
בַּ before הַיּוֹם is unrepresented because the ASV writes the temporal phrase bare as 'the third day'.
